morphology.pattern_note: 外来宗教称谓，整词作为独立词素记忆；末尾 -tor 不是这里的马来语后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 牧师：基督教教会的教职人员，尤指若干新教教会中负责牧养会众者。
senses.en_definition: A Christian minister, especially one responsible for the pastoral care of a Protestant congregation.
senses.ms_definition: Paderi terutamanya bagi gereja selain Gereja Katolik, Gereja England dan Gereja Scotland.
senses.nuances: 马来语普通名词写 pastor；置于姓名前作为称谓时通常写 Pastor Daniel。DBP 的定义列出特定教会范围，实际称谓仍应依所属教会惯例，不宜把所有基督教神职人员一律称为 pastor。[DBP：pastor](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=gereja)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Seorang pastor daripada gereja tempatan turut menyertai program bantuan makanan untuk penduduk yang terjejas akibat banjir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 当地教会的一名牧师也参与了为受洪灾影响居民提供食物援助的活动。
dual_scenarios.en: A pastor from a local church also took part in the food relief programme for residents affected by the floods.

dual_scenarios.en: Has Pastor Daniel arrived at the hall yet?

etymology.historical_story: Pastor ultimately comes from Latin pastor, meaning shepherd. Christian tradition applied the image of caring for a flock to guiding a congregation, giving the word its religious meaning. Malay uses pastor as a church title. The shepherd image helps explain why the role includes personal guidance and care alongside preaching and leading worship. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pastor)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pastor 与“牧师”的“牧”连起来：照顾羊群的牧人，引申为照顾会众的人。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼本人时可用 Pastor 加姓名；正式转述中，beliau 可表达尊重。优先采用该教会及本人惯用的称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于基督教语境。天主教神父等其他教职人员的称谓，应依其教会惯例使用；跨宗教活动中也应准确保留各自头衔。
